mapper.select: SELECT workspace_id, enabled, host, port, username, password_enc, from_address, from_name, starttls, `ssl`, `auth`, updated_at FROM workspace_mail_config WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_mail_config (workspace_id, enabled, host, port, username, password_enc, from_address, from_name, starttls, `ssl`, `auth`) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{enabled}, #{host}, #{port}, #{username}, #{passwordEnc}, #{fromAddress}, #{fromName}, #{starttls}, #{ssl}, #{auth}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enabled = VALUES(enabled), host = VALUES(host), port = VALUES(port), username = VALUES(username), password_enc = VALUES(password_enc), from_address = VALUES(from_address), from_name = VALUES(from_name), starttls = VALUES(starttls), `ssl` = VALUES(`ssl`), `auth` = VALUES(`auth`)
